preconditions.description: The number of cities N is between 3 and 500, and the number of roads M is between 3 and 10,000.
Each of the M lines contains exactly three integers: X_i, Y_i, Z_i.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 500 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split()[:2])
preconditions.description: City indices X_i and Y_i are between 1 and N (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(z) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for z in line.split()[2:])
preconditions.description: Importance values Z_i are between 1 and 100,000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(int(x) != int(y) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()[:2]])
preconditions.description: No road connects a city to itself (X_i ≠ Y_i).

preconditions.expression: len({(int(x), int(y)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()[:2]]}) == len({(int(x), int(y)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()[:2]]})
preconditions.description: The input is well-formed (no duplicate lines, though multiple roads between the same pair of cities are allowed).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 500 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split()[:2]) and all(1 <= int(z) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for z in line.split()[2:])
postconditions.description: The input constraints are respected in the output computation.

The output is the product of separation numbers for all unordered pairs of cities modulo 10^9 + 7, where the separation number for a pair (A, B) is the minimal sum of importance values of a good subset of roads (a subset whose removal disconnects A from B).
